_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on pterodactyl/game-eggs' Clone Hero egg (MIT).
name: Clone Hero
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Online play for Clone Hero, the guitar and drums rhythm game. Installs the standalone server release you choose for the node's CPU.
startup: if [ -n "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ]; then set -- -ps "${SERVER_PASSWORD}"; else set -- -np; fi; exec ./Server -l {{LOG_LEVEL}} -n "{{SERVER_DISPLAY_NAME}}" -a 0.0.0.0 -p {{SERVER_PORT}} "$@"

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Clone Hero. Downloads the standalone server from Clone Hero's GitHub
# releases (checked against GitHub's SHA-256) and keeps the program for the
# node's CPU. settings.ini and the ban list are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

repo=clonehero-game/releases
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=linux-x64 ;;
aarch64) arch=linux-arm64 ;;
*) fail "Clone Hero has no server for this CPU ($(uname -m))." ;;
esac
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build"
mkdir -p "$build"

# Releases are tagged like v1.1.0.6161-final; take 1.1.0.6161 as well.
tag=""
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" latest) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
else
    for t in "$want" "v$want" "v$want-final" "$want-final" "v${want#[vV]}" "v${want#[vV]}-final"; do
        if tag=$(gh-release tag "$repo" "$t" 2>/dev/null); then break; fi
        tag=""
    done
    [ -n "$tag" ] || fail "Clone Hero has no release $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as v1.1.0.6161-final."
fi
assets=$(gh-release assets "$repo" "$tag") || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
asset=$(awk '!f && tolower($1) ~ /standalone.?server.*\.zip$/ { print $1; f = 1 }' <<<"$assets")
[ -n "$asset" ] || fail "Clone Hero $tag has no standalone server download."
sum=$(awk -v a="$asset" '$1 == a { print $2 }' <<<"$assets")

if [ -x Server ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-clonehero 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag $arch $sum" ]; then
    echo "Clone Hero $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading Clone Hero $tag"
    gh-release download "$repo" "$tag" "$asset" "$build/server.zip" || fail "The download failed. Reinstall to try again."
    # The zip's layout changes between releases: find this CPU's program.
    path=$(unzip -Z1 "$build/server.zip" | grep -E "(^|/)$arch/Server$") || true
    path=$(head -n 1 <<<"$path")
    [ -n "$path" ] || fail "Clone Hero $tag has no server for $arch."
    unzip -q -j "$build/server.zip" "$path" -d "$build/x"
    chmod +x "$build/x/Server"
    mv -f "$build/x/Server" Server
    echo "$tag $arch $sum" > .raptor-clonehero
fi
# The server fills in the rest of its settings on first start.
[ -f settings.ini ] || printf '[online]\nmaxplayers = 4\n' > settings.ini
echo "Installed Clone Hero $tag ($arch)."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Clone Hero release to install, such as v1.1.0.6161-final, or latest.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see when they join.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with: letters, digits and underscores. Empty lets anyone join.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can play at once.

variables.name: Log level
variables.description: How much the server logs, from 0 (errors only) to 4 (everything).
